payload.claim: The comment on the GateResult branch of describe() still says the line renders 'at the baseline and each attempt's suite', but this diff adds a third source for these events: _judge now emits GateResult events with against="rebuttal" too, rendered by this same branch. The task's own notes explicitly called out that this two-line comment needed updating ('Its two-line comment names only the baseline and attempt suites, so update that comment'), but the diff leaves it unchanged, so the comment now misdescribes which suites produce this line. No gate catches this since format/lint/types/tests do not check comment accuracy.
